# pvecli vm lock

Lock a VM - requires root@pam authentication.

```text
pvecli vm lock [VMID] [LOCK_TYPE] [OPTIONS]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `VMID` | VM ID. |
| `LOCK_TYPE` | Lock type: backup, clone, create, migrate, rollback, snapshot, snapshot-delete, suspending, suspended. |

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
